newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Friday:
Spokesman Thierry Daman said Commissioner Bonino would return on Sunday from Iraq. He said Bonino would meet the press on Monday, but no time had been set.

In response to questions, he said nothing new had happened concerning the request by the Commission for a joint-committee meeting with Morocco on fish issues. He said the Commission had asked twice for such a meeting but so far without any positive response from Rabat.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/746: EU seeks candidates for study trips to learn business culture of Japan
- IP/97/747: Commission approving 91 million Ecus in cohesion fund aid for environmental projects in Spain
